name: Home Assistant
author: Waveshare Widgets
description: Entity states from Home Assistant with touch control for lights and switches. Locks and covers stay display-only until you arm them, and then need a long press.

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.label: Home Assistant address
properties.help: The address you open Home Assistant on, including the port — typically http://homeassistant.local:8123. Use an https:// address if you have one (a Nabu Casa URL, or a local certificate): every poll sends the token below in an Authorization header, and over plain http that credential crosses your network in the clear.

properties.name: accessToken
properties.label: Long-lived access token
properties.help: A Home Assistant long-lived access token: click your user name in the sidebar, then Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token. It carries YOUR account’s permissions, so a token from an admin account can act on anything that account can — consider a limited user for the panel.

fields.label: Locks & covers
fields.placeholder: blank = show only · allow = long-press to control
